spans.s:
ईप्सन n. (-नं) Desiring, wishing to obtain.
 E. आप् to obtain, desiderative
form, ल्युट् aff.

ईप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired.
 E. आप् to obtain, desiderative
form, क्त aff.

ईप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous, wishing to get or obtain.
 E. आप् to ob-
tain, desiderative form, उस् aff.
